name: VRM_PERF_OBLIG_REF_LINES_GT
description: This table contains performance obligation reference lines-related information.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line.

columns.name: PREV_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference document line. E.g. For return lines, the original line identifier is referred. For version lines, the first version line is referred.

columns.name: CHILD_LINE_SEQ_NUMBER
columns.description: Order in which return or version lines should be processed for a given document line in the current batch.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_MODEL
columns.description: Specifies how satisfaction will be measured and recorded for a performance obligation line. Values are from lookup type ORA_VRM_SATIS_MEAS_MODEL.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of the return or version line.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount of the return or version line.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: REVENUE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the revenue must be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Number of periods in which the revenue of this  performance obligation line is to be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date until which revenue must be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_REVERSAL_METHOD
columns.description: Revenue reversal method used to reverse the revenue.

columns.name: DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Fulfillment date of a source document line.

columns.name: VERSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current source product line is a version line. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: The version of the source product line.

columns.name: MAX_SATISFACTION_EVENT_NUM
columns.description: Highest satisfaction measurement number under the performance obligation line.

columns.name: POL_FIRST_DISCARDED_SE_DATE
columns.description: Date from which satisfaction events of a performance obligation line are to be discarded.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_BASE_PROPORTION
columns.description: Base number for the satisfaction schedule proportions. The default value is 100. The base number is updated when the schedule rows are updated. It is the sum of the numerator of the ratio of all schedules.

columns.name: PROCESSING_TYPE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Used to identify how the processing of return or version lines should be done for creating satisfaction events.

columns.name: LINE_STATUS
columns.description: Return or version source document line status while processing for satisfaction events creation. Used during internal processing.

columns.name: COST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cost of the inventory item or memo line in the transaction currency. This column is used to calculate the gross margin percentage.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: Unit list price of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: Gross margin percentage of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION
columns.description: Duration of service item in terms of the service unit of measure.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: The allocation currency basis used to allocate and recognize revenue for a contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOCATION_METHOD.
